source_findings.finding: applied-effort readback is explicit input provenance; projected effort is not independently calibrated actuator torque or hardware tau_J.
R3 collector repeats final load application point for the entire oracle; nonzero-load moment truth is not a per-step application-point log.
R3 online evaluator reports rank/condition but its rejection logic does not enforce them or invoke the full P2-4 observer contract.
R3 effort_rate_bounds is applied as a per-step increment without dt; it is not enforced Nm/s.
R3 pre_gains is read after zeroing; runtime_drive_gains_zero is assigned true, not an independent per-step gain assertion.
Single FR3 source checks do not qualify original bilateral L-tool constrained dynamics, actual grasp identity or contact wrench observability.
Existing contact-mode transitions validate endpoint metadata, closure and collision; they explicitly do not prove edge safety. Offline synthetic attachment evidence is not actual runtime feedback.
R12 is joint-velocity QP plus torque impedance/adapter; offline 54D HQP already has wrench/internal objectives but remains an ideal source-conditional model.
